 • Driveways and parking lots: Outdoor cameras can monitor vehicles and ensure overall safety in common parking spaces.

 • Living room or lounge areas: In spaces that are clearly designated as common areas, a camera can monitor general movement without focusing on guest interactions in private settings.
 • Hallways or entry corridors: If your layout includes hallways connecting common spaces, these areas can be monitored to track entry and exit flow while avoiding private room interiors.

Remember, there should be absolutely no surveillance in private spaces such as bedrooms and bathrooms. By focusing monitoring on external and commonly used areas—and by ensuring guests are informed of any installed systems—you balance property oversight with guest comfort and privacy.
